text:
Sam L: FYI ran into a nasty one integrating rerank into the sample-app, batching helper seems to sometimes send malformed vectors when retry kicks in. :grimacing:
Maria D: ugh, details? is this the padding/dim mismatch we've seen before? :eyes:
Sam L: It looks like node SDK retry duplicates one of the batch items but with an empty vector, server returns 400: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
{"queries": [{"id": "q1", "query": "...", "vectors": [[0.1,0.2,...]]}, {"id": "q2", "query": "...", "vectors": []}]}
```
Sam L: Empty vector triggers unhelpful error and client code crashes when trying to deserialize response arrays.
Kevin Zhao: Can you paste the full response body? is it returning `embeddings` vs `vectors` fields? Node vs Python parity bug could cause field name swap.
Sam L: Response is 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid vector dims: expected 1536 got 0"}` but the SDK wrapper turns that into an exception that triggers a retry, which then resends a partial batch.
Chloe (devex): Sounds like two separate issues colliding: (1) retry idempotency not filtering failed items, (2) batching helper not validating shapes before enqueue.
Maria D: We added a quick guard in python sample-app to assert shape before adding to batch: `if len(vec) != MODEL_DIM: raise ValueError` — maybe we should add same in node helper.
Kevin Zhao: Node helper currently does shallow check `Array.isArray(vec)` only. I'll add strict length check + a small sanitizer that pads/truncates to expected dim with explicit warning logs.
Sam L: Padding is ok as a workaround but we need clear behavior documented. Right now python endpoint expects exact length, node silently pads in some branches, so parity is broken.
Chloe (devex): Agreed — propose these action items: 1) node SDK: strict dim check + deterministic pad/truncate with warning; 2) batching helper: validate before enqueue and drop/mark bad items; 3) retry logic: do not retry on 4xx validation errors; 4) update sample-apps and quickstart to show canonical sanitization.
Maria D: Also saw a subtle response format mismatch in a different thread: some older models returned `vectors` list of lists, newer ones use `embeddings`. Clients need to accept both. We should add a small compatibility shim in SDKs.
Kevin Zhao: I'll implement: normalizeResponse(resp) => { embeddings: resp.embeddings || resp.vectors || [] } in both sdks.
Sam L: CI caught a flake where CI-bot retried failed integration tests and made the queue dupes worse — tagging ci-bot for backoff tweaks.
Chloe (devex): @ci-bot can we introduce a 2s jittered backoff and cap retries for 4xx to 0?
Sam L: For immediate unblock, I pushed a quick change to sample-app: local validation + explicit error catch around rerank call so UX shows 'vector shape mismatch' instead of crash. Patch link: https://git.internal/repo/sample-app/commit/3a1f8
Maria D: thanks. Can we add a tiny e2e that simulates partial empty vector and asserts sdk doesn't retry and surface error cleanly?
Kevin Zhao: Yep — will add test and a changelog note under node sdk breaking-behavior -> fixed.
Chloe (devex): I'll update quickstart docs and add a short note about "expected dim" and example sanitizer for Node/Py.
Sam L: Great. If anyone hits this and needs a hotfix ping me, I left a debug trace in the sample-app logs: `rerank.batch: enqueue q2 with vec_len=0`
Maria D: :thumbsup: closing loop once PRs are merged.
ci-bot: Scheduled retry suppressed for 4xx errors (rule updated).
